sources.snippet: This is the largest build of the Phonon-1 family, an open speech recognition model for English that downloads in 581 MB.

sources.title: GitHub - fermionresearch/phonon
sources.snippet: Phonon-1 is an open speech recognition model for English. It downloads in 415 MB, runs on a laptop or a datacenter GPU, and transcribes an hour of audio in about two and a half minutes. It was trained at 2.4 bits per weight from the start, and it is the second model in the lab's low-bit lane after Neutrino-1. Models: Phonon-1 · Phonon-1-Micro · Phonon-1-Big

sources.snippet: Phonon-1 Micro The smallest speech model. It trades accuracy for a smaller download and is selected with --model micro.
